_help: Free items to give away. To add an item: 1) drop photos into public/items/ (e.g. public/items/lamp-1.jpg), 2) add an entry below with images like "/items/lamp-1.jpg", 3) redeploy (vercel --prod) or just ask Devin/Hermes. Set status to 'pending' when someone claims it, 'claimed' to hide it. Contact can be a WhatsApp link like https://wa.me/60123456789
